✅ THIS EXTRACT IS VERIFIED UNTRUNCATED — 110 of 110. tools/verify_extract.py shares no code with
the extractor: it re-derives each function's end from the authority with its own character state
machine and compares line counts, non-whitespace character counts, then full content, and asserts
each body's last line closes its function and was not brace-padded. Two negative controls confirm
it bites: a tail cut re-balanced with a bare `}` was caught as 'extract body never closes', and a
brace-balanced 4-line cut from the middle as 'LENGTH MISMATCH 85 vs 81'. It also caught a real bug
in the extractor's first draft, where a trailing comment on the `{` line was being dropped.
